notes: γένηται αὐτῷ is read as 'he might have' with the dative supplying the English subject; giving 'he' to the verb and leaving αὐτῷ unrepresented would strand a content token.
χρονοτριβῆσαι heads on 'spend' as the compound's verbal core (rule 66), as παραπλεῦσαι keeps 'past' for its preverb under rule 106.
